logline: 똑같이 생긴 왕자와 거지 아이가 옷을 바꿔 입었다가 서로의 자리에 갇힌다.
destination: 런던 거리 — 왕자가 처음으로 밖에서 맞는 밤
protagonist: 단정하게 자른 금발에 비단옷을 입은 열두 살 소년
anchor: a twelve-year-old English boy with neatly cut fair hair and fine silk clothes
palette: palace gold and crimson, alley grey, cold river blue, warm amber

prince.label: 왕자
prince.desc: a twelve-year-old English boy, neatly cut fair hair, crimson silk doublet with gold braid, white hose

pauper.label: 거지 아이
pauper.desc: a twelve-year-old English boy with the same face, matted fair hair, ragged brown smock, bare dirty feet
pauper.avoid: 얼굴은 왕자와 같다 — 머리와 옷만 다르다

guards.label: 궁전 위병
guards.desc: Tudor palace guards in scarlet tunics with black hats, holding tall halberds

palace_room.label: 궁전 방
palace_room.desc: a Tudor palace chamber, linenfold panelling, leaded window, heavy carved chest

beats.visual: a ragged boy clinging to palace railings while guards move to push him back
beats.motion: a guard's halberd swings toward him, he grips the railings, dust kicks up

beats.beat: 안에서 나온 소년이 그를 데리고 들어간다.
beats.visual: a boy in crimson silk leading a ragged boy in through a palace gateway
beats.motion: the two walk forward through the gateway, the silk sleeve lifts, guards step aside

beats.visual: two boys with identical faces standing side by side before a tall mirror in a panelled room
beats.motion: they turn toward the mirror together, candle flames lean, the glass catches both faces

beats.visual: a boy pulling a crimson silk doublet over his ragged smock in a panelled chamber
beats.motion: the doublet slides down over his shoulders, the smock falls to the floor, light shifts

beats.visual: guards shoving a boy in a ragged smock out through a palace door into an alley
beats.motion: they push him forward out the door, the door swings shut, refuse scatters

beats.visual: a boy in a ragged smock halted in a narrow sooty London alley at dusk, washing overhead
beats.motion: washing flaps above him, he turns on the spot, smoke drifts along the alley

beats.beat: 비단옷 입은 아이가 큰 의자 앞에 선다.
beats.visual: a boy in crimson silk standing before a tall carved chair in an empty panelled chamber
beats.motion: he steps toward the chair, candle flames bend, his hand rises to the carved arm

beats.beat: 빈 방에 누더기 한 벌만 떨어져 있다.
beats.visual: a ragged brown smock lying on the floor of an empty panelled chamber, window light
beats.motion: window light creeps across the floor, the cloth stirs, dust turns in the beam

withheld: 두 아이가 제자리를 되찾는 과정과, 왕자가 왕이 되어 내리는 결정
